recordedProductIssues: Cut-out inset of the highlighted button sits on a black mask strip with a tiny unreadable sub-label
Many black masks over form fields on the dimmed review screen

defects.problem: Hook shows a tiny synthetic billing UI whose text is unreadable at feed size; only the headline carries the muted hook, and the screenshot takes ~70% of the frame as grey detail
defects.fix: Give the headline and the Cancel subscription button more of the frame, or crop layout so the button is the visible subject, without zooming the footage

defects.problem: Dim scrim dissolve overlaps ghosted old headline with the new layout; headline reflows from large stacked text to small label plus yellow There., a layout jump
defects.fix: Make the dissolve a clean cross-fade with the headline fully gone before the new screen resolves, or hold the same text position

defects.problem: Right column inset and its caption (Same highlight, detail from the recorded guide, iPhone 16 self-demo) is too small to read at 600 px and the inset has a black bar at its base
defects.fix: Enlarge the caption or drop it, trim the black mask strip from the inset crop edge

defects.problem: Large empty space between the 16:9 image and the bottom caption band, cramped small-print second line
defects.fix: Tighten vertical spacing so image, caption and sub-caption sit as one block

oneLineVerdict: Stable and honest, but the hook is a small grey UI with unreadable detail and a jumpy mid-section layout swap.
